Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: PURPOSE: Post a Nivelacija. Validates every gate, recomputes every line from the price-event log, then writes the new prices onto the batches, emits the price events, and closes the document.

Step.name: Insert Text
Step.Text:
PARAMS (JSON): nivelacijaId required. Must be Otvorena and must have at least one line.
RETURNS data: brojNivelacije, brojStavki, and the seven totals as written.
ERRORS: NIV_NOT_OPEN already posted, or does not exist NIV_EMPTY no lines NIV_CHRONOLOGY_CONFLICT a batch already has a LATER price event than this document NIV_BACKDATE_PRICE_CHANGE backdated, stock moved in the window, and the price is not neutral NIV_IDENTITY_VIOLATION a line where razlika ≠ RUC + PDV
TWO PASSES, AND THE ORDER IS THE WHOLE POINT: Pass one validates and computes everything into memory. Pass two writes. Nothing is written until every gate has passed on every line, so a rejected document is left exactly as it was rather than half posted. epSQL gives no transaction to roll back into, so the discipline has to live in the control flow.
EVERYTHING IS RECOMPUTED, NOTHING IS TRUSTED: The old side of every line is re-resolved from CijeneStavki as of this document's own date, and every quantity is re-derived from the invoice ledger as of that date. The draft values written by NIV__GenerateStavke are overwritten. A stale browser tab can therefore never post a wrong number — the only things taken from the line are the operator's INTENT: the anchor and, under NovaMPC, the target price.
GATE 1 — CHRONOLOGY. A document may not insert a price event behind one that already exists for the same batch, because the later event's "stara cijena" was recorded against a price this document would now be changing. Sort key is ( VaziOd, TipPrioritet, IzvorBroj ).
GATE 2 — BACKDATE NEUTRALITY. Backdating is allowed, but only where it changes nothing that has already been sold. If stock moved between the effective date and today, the line must be price neutral. This is what makes the VAT-registration nivelacija legal to backdate: it holds bruto, so every sale in the window was invoiced at exactly the right price and nothing leaks.
GATE 3 — IDENTITY. razlika = RUC + PDV must hold on every line to the cent. Because cost never moves, this is an algebraic certainty; if it fails, something wrote a line that did not respect the anchor.
DECIMALS: every fraction is an integer ratio ( 1 + pct / 100 ). A dot decimal literal pastes as an EMPTY calculation on this file's comma-decimal locale and silently evaluates to zero.

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: ── Commit first. An epSQL UPDATE against a record the current session still holds open returns error 301, and this script updates StavkePrimke rows the operator may have been looking at. ──

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: ── Load the lines. Only the operator's intent is taken from them: the anchor and, under NovaMPC, the target price. Everything else is re-derived below. ──

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: ── Read the result set into a JSON array immediately. epSQL keeps exactly one named result set alive per name and the next query would overwrite it. ──

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: ── GATE 1: chronology. Any event on one of this document's batches whose sort key is above this document's own key means the document is being inserted behind history that already refers to a price it is about to change. TipPrioritet never exceeds 2, so the comparison reduces to a later date, or the same date with a nivelacija whose number sorts higher. ──

Value.Calculation: epSQLExecute ( "SELECT CijeneStavki.ForeignKeyStavkaPrimkeID, CijeneStavki.VaziOd," & " CijeneStavki.TipPrioritet, CijeneStavki.IzvorBroj" & " FROM CijeneStavki" & " WHERE CijeneStavki.VaziOd >= " & epSQLQuoteDate ( $docDate ) ; "useSQLResult=rs_chr" )

Step.name: If
# (comment)
Step.Text: ── As-of resolution, query 1 of 3: the price event in force on this document's date, with the batch's total received quantity riding along. Same walk as NIV__GetCandidates — last row per batch wins. ──

Value.Calculation: epSQLExecute ( "SELECT CijeneStavki.ForeignKeyStavkaPrimkeID, CijeneStavki.Cijena," & " CijeneStavki.PDVPostotak, CijeneStavki.NabavnaCijenaEfektivna, StavkePrimke.Kolicina" & " FROM CijeneStavki" & " JOIN StavkePrimke ON StavkePrimke.PrimaryKey = CijeneStavki.ForeignKeyStavkaPrimkeID" & " WHERE CijeneStavki.VaziOd <= " & epSQLQuoteDate ( $docDate ) & " ORDER BY CijeneStavki.ForeignKeyStavkaPrimkeID, CijeneStavki.VaziOd," & " CijeneStavki.TipPrioritet, CijeneStavki.IzvorBroj" ; "useSQLResult=rs_evt" )

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: ── As-of resolution, query 2 of 3: consumption up to the document date, and separately anything consumed AFTER it. Grouped by invoice date rather than a CASE expression, because FileMaker SQL support for CASE is not something to bet a posting run on; the two buckets are split in the loop instead. The second map is what GATE 2 tests: a backdated line whose stock moved in the window must be price neutral. Grouped by status so the sign is applied here — Predracun consumes nothing, Reklamacija adds back. ──

Value.Calculation: epSQLExecute ( "SELECT InvoiceLines.ForeignKeyStavkaUlazneFakture, Invoices.StatusDokumenta," & " SUM ( InvoiceLines.Qty ), Invoices.Datum" & " FROM InvoiceLines" & " JOIN Invoices ON Invoices.PrimaryKey = InvoiceLines.ForeignKeyInvoiceID" & " WHERE Invoices.ForeignKeyCompanyID = ?" & " AND Invoices.Datum <= " & epSQLQuoteDate ( Get ( CurrentDate ) ) & " GROUP BY InvoiceLines.ForeignKeyStavkaUlazneFakture, Invoices.StatusDokumenta, Invoices.Datum" ; "useSQLResult=rs_con" ; $companyId )

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: ── As-of resolution, query 3 of 3: returns to supplier up to the document date. Separate query — consumption and returns are two children of the same batch and one join would cross-multiply both sums. ──

Value.Calculation: epSQLExecute ( "SELECT StavkePovrata.ForeignKeyStavkaPrimkeID, SUM ( StavkePovrata.Kolicina )" & " FROM StavkePovrata" & " JOIN PovratiDobavljacima ON PovratiDobavljacima.PrimaryKey = StavkePovrata.ForeignKeyPovratID" & " WHERE PovratiDobavljacima.DatumPovrata <= " & epSQLQuoteDate ( $docDate ) & " GROUP BY StavkePovrata.ForeignKeyStavkaPrimkeID" ; "useSQLResult=rs_ret" )

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: ── PASS ONE: recompute every line and run GATES 2 and 3. Nothing is written in this pass. The computed lines accumulate in $calc and only reach the database if every gate passes on every line. ──

Value.Calculation: GetAsNumber ( JSONGetElement ( $state ; "primljeno" ) ) - GetAsNumber ( JSONGetElement ( $cons ; $batchId ) ) - GetAsNumber ( JSONGetElement ( $rets ; $batchId ) )

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: ── GATE 2: backdate neutrality. Stock moved between the effective date and today, so the price this document sets must equal the price those sales were invoiced at. If it does not, the difference has already walked out of the door and the ledger can never be made to balance. ──

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: ── GATE 3: the identity. Because cost never moves this is algebraically exact, and computing PDV as a subtraction makes it exact after rounding too. A failure here is a real defect, not a rounding artefact. ──

Value.Calculation: Log.add ( "error" ; "POST_REJECTED" ; $broj & " odbijena prije upisa — ništa nije promijenjeno." ; "{}" )

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: ── PASS TWO: write. Every gate has passed on every line, so from here the only failures possible are database ones. Order within a line: rewrite the line, move the batch to its new price and rate, then emit the price event that records the move. ──

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: ── The price event. KeyEvent is written explicitly and the auto-enter calculation also fires on an epSQL INSERT (measured 2026-09-07), so the column is set twice with the same string — harmless, and it means the uniqueness validation on it is genuinely active against these inserts rather than bypassed. ──

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: ── Close the document. Totals are the sum of the rounded lines, accumulated above, never a re-rounding of a sum — so the printed columns add up to the printed total. ──
